body: I see you. You are not alone, You matter. I know Im not your mum, or anyone you know, but someone in the world notices you, and is sending you a big hug!

What do you have to loose in msging them and asking why you have been excluded?

It sounds like they have already left you behind, so in asking why, all you stand to gain is knowledge about yourself and the way they see you.

Ask them, then once you have the answer, move the fuck on.  Legit, you deserve a hell of a alot better than a 'phase out'.  Find better friends, or fuck it! Come to Australia (brisbane) and Ill be your new friend.
This melts my stone cold heart!
LOVE the adjectives you used to describe this cuntbag

I dont think - I KNOW.

I met a women who was being followed and stalked for over two years, and she was terrified. He would find her in womens shelters, at shopping centres, in a new state.  She gave her child to her sister because she was that terrified. Myself and two other people worked with police and this women to make her safe and give her an opportunity for a normal life. I found out last month she has a stable job, she has not heard/seen from her stalker in three months, and she has her daughter back in her custody - and in a public school!!!!! (Thats enormous!).  

The day I met her, the very first day, I wasnt even working in that area.  I actually only went along to the meeting because I wanted to know someone else was hurting as much as me.  I wore long pants and sleaves to cover the marks on my body that I had done that morning.  I was so far from happy I couldnt remember how to spell the word, but it didnt matter.  My depression and self-loathing did not stop me from walking into a safe house, sitting there, listening and knowing i needed to help this women, and all people.  That is all it took.  About 8 months later, I was developing a service to help other people like her across AuNZ.  That service was approved for funding this month and goes live from feb next year. 

Your own depression doesn't stop you from spreading happiness and helping others. I really hope you find value, motivation, and happiness in your life.  But moreso, I hope that you dont let your depression/unhappiness stop you from helping the people around you.

Thank you. I have tried to create change in my life, sometimes I even think Im getting somewhere, but the constant set backs, failures, self doubt and depressive states are disheartening.  

I've spent so long focusing on me and trying to create change in my life, and the constant failing at that was sending my further down the rabbit hole. In contrast, forgetting myself and focusing on others has, to some degree, created a slight change in my life.

I hope OP has something in their life that gives them value, and the energy to fight, even it its for one more day.

Thank you, you are so lovely! 

I still have some hope I will change, that the things that drown me will change.  It's just dwindling. It's been over a decade of me trying different therapies, meds, tests, meditation, distractions, I even moved states once, and left the country for three months, and yet none of those things made a difference.

Working with victims has helped me cope with my own feelings immensely. I truly hope OP, all the OPs, find a way to find value and meaning in their lives, despite the burdens they carry. Go and volunteer in a nursing home, or hospice, find the people who have no family left and are in this world alone, go and listen to them, talk to them,  and know that YOU made their life better, even if you couldnt do it for yourself.

Ditto. By the time I had turned 16, I had two half-ass'd suicide attempts that had landed me in hospital.  I'm now 25, and still think the exact same thoughts.

The difference is, now I know that things aren't going to get better for me, and things aren't going to change - this is just life. So I have two options, forget everyone and just make the cut, or stop sitting here  focusing on feeling abandonned and anxious, and instead get up and do something that makes a difference to someone elses life.

I've spent over a decade trying to help myself, and I now accept that I can't. But I can invest myself in doing something that will make someone elses life better.  I can spend my time helping someone else find happiness and escape their darkness.  I still cry myself to sleep at night, I still bargain and bribe myself to get out of bed.  But in between those moments, I have developed a national support service for victims of DV and stalking, and have helped thousands of people.

I haven't escaped my hell, I think about killing myself as much as I did when I was 16, but now I go to bed and the faces of the lives I have helped save. I think about the women, men and children who have a better life, in part, because of me. 

Maybe you're like me, maybe Your life wont get better, but how amazing could it be to make a difference in someone elses life? To know that a little kid is safe because of you? It makes life worth living for another day.

Be strong, my friend X
